info.title: Wolff API
info.description: Quote-to-cash API for agencies and freelancers. Public routes require a workspace API key passed in the Authorization header as `Bearer qc_sk_...`.

secret.description: The signing secret. Returned once, on creation, and never again.

get.description: Returns the webhook endpoints registered for the workspace of the API key.

post.description: Registers a new endpoint to receive outbound webhook events. The signing secret is returned only in this response.

delete.description: Deletes the endpoint and stops future deliveries.
